Summary: DG-001: PII Classification Rules, Taxonomy & Field-Type Mapping
Description: Nathan to update and share final masking requirements document. DG Team to define: (1) PII taxonomy with sensitivity labels (SSN, EMAIL, DOB etc.), (2) field-type classification — joinable fields (SSN, email) → deterministic hashing; free-text fields → redact-all; non-joinable PII → masking function. Output is a signed-off requirements document consumed by MP-001 and MP-002.

Summary: DG-002: DG Metadata Catalog Ownership & Access Model
Description: Governance team to confirm DG metadata catalog ownership model: functions/tags owned centrally in DG metadata catalog; engineers only tag columns. Define access control for who can create/modify masking functions vs. who can only apply tags. Output: ownership matrix and access model doc.

Rahul / Scott to review hashing strength (salting) with security/ITRC team. Determine approved hash algorithm and salting strategy for deterministic hashing on joinable fields (SSN, email). Output: approved hashing specification consumed by MP-003.

Summary: DG-004: Auto-Classification Testing for Free-Text Fields
Description: Rahul / Governance to test auto-classification especially for free-text field tagging. Validate that free-text PII columns are correctly auto-tagged and routed to redact-all policy. Output: classification test results and approved tagging ruleset.
DG Team to define audit dashboard requirements: what must be logged (access events, mask-applied vs bypass), anomaly thresholds, and reporting cadence for compliance. Output: audit requirements spec.

Summary: PILOT-001: Select Pilot PII Column & Define End-to-End Test Plan
Description: Paulam / Scott / Alok to select one PII column for end-to-end pilot (function → tag → policy). Preferred candidate: EMAIL (joinable, deterministic hash). Define test plan: expected masked output, join correctness check, DG review checkpoint. DEPENDS ON: DG-001.

Summary: PILOT-002: Implement Pilot Masking — One Column End-to-End
Description: Balaji implements full masking stack for the pilot column: (1) create deterministic hash function in DG metadata catalog per DG-003 spec, (2) apply UC column tag per DG-001 taxonomy, (3) bind masking policy in Unity Catalog. Paulam reviews each step. DEPENDS ON: PILOT-001, DG-003.

DG Team reviews pilot column masking output: validate hash output format, join correctness, policy binding, and tag accuracy. Go/No-Go decision to proceed with full rollout. Team to set recurring working session per action item. DEPENDS ON: PILOT-002.

Summary: MP-001: Full PII Column Inventory, Tagging & Classification
Description: Following pilot sign-off: catalog ALL PII columns across Redshift schemas. Apply UC column tags per DG-001 taxonomy (joinable → hash tag, free-text → redact tag, non-joinable → mask tag). Engineers tag columns only; functions owned by DG metadata catalog. DEPENDS ON: PILOT-003, DG-004.

Summary: MP-002: Masking Function Library — Full Build in DG Metadata Catalog
Description: Balaji builds full masking function library in DG metadata catalog: (1) deterministic hash function (salted, per DG-003 spec) for joinable fields, (2) redact-all function for free-text fields, (3) partial mask / nullify for non-joinable PII. Policies must exist per catalog. Paulam reviews. DEPENDS ON: DG-001, DG-003, PILOT-003.

Summary: MP-003: ABAC Tag-Driven Policy Framework (All PII Types)
Description: Implement ABAC policy framework: Function + Tag + Masking Policy pattern per catalog. CREATE COLUMN MASK / ROW FILTER policies that evaluate CURRENT_USER() group membership against UC tags. Covers all three policy types: hash, redact-all, partial mask. DEPENDS ON: MP-001, MP-002, DG-002.

Summary: MP-004: Column Mask Policy Binding — All PII Tables
Description: Balaji applies ALTER TABLE ... SET MASK bindings to all tagged PII columns across bronze/silver layers. Validate per-catalog policy existence. Paulam validates propagation. DEPENDS ON: MP-003.

Summary: MP-005: Role & Group Mapping for Masking Exemptions
Description: Create Unity Catalog groups (data_steward, pii_reader, masked_reader) per DG-002 access model. Configure masking policies to pass-through for privileged roles. Disable direct S3 access — enforce all access via Unity Catalog. DEPENDS ON: DG-002, MP-004.

Validate deterministic hash on joinable fields (SSN, email) produces consistent output for correct join results. Implement pre/post reconciliation logic. Confirm no partial-reveal on hashed columns. DEPENDS ON: MP-004, MP-005.
Validate DLT-Meta pipelines respect UC masking at read time. Confirm silver/gold materialized views do not expose raw PII. Verify direct S3 access is fully disabled. DEPENDS ON: MP-006.

Summary: MP-008: DABs Packaging for Multi-Environment Deployment
Description: Package masking functions, tags, and policy bindings in Databricks Asset Bundles for dev/qa/prod. Scott reviews architecture. DEPENDS ON: MP-007.

Build Lakeview dashboard on system.access per DG-005 spec: PII access by user, mask-applied vs bypass ratio, anomaly alerts, per-catalog policy hit tracking. Balaji supports query development. DEPENDS ON: DG-005, MP-004.

Summary: MP-010: UAT & Full Data Governance Sign-off
Description: DG Team conducts full UAT: validate all PII types (hash, redact-all, partial mask), user role exemptions, audit dashboard, and S3 lockdown. Scott signs off on architecture. Team sets recurring iteration session. DEPENDS ON: MP-008, MP-009.
